targets.name: Trustpilot
targets.notes: The ONLY target in this block that fits every property - Trustpilot takes any business with customers, not just software or agencies. Free account ('Create Your Free Account'), three-step flow: business details (location, name, website), personal details, account activation. reCAPTCHA-gated. Profile goes live on domain claim without editorial gatekeeping; paid plans add review invitations and widgets. Note business.trustpilot.com/signup 301-redirects to the signup subdomain - use the redirect target directly.

targets.name: Clutch
targets.notes: Best-fit anchor for the consulting s.r.o. Free 'Basic' tier explicitly limits you: basic company info, basic analytics, limited case studies, NO Clutch verification, competitors stay visible on your profile, ranked below verified providers. Real ranking driver is verified client reviews collected by Clutch phone interview - your referenceable clients are the asset here, so line them up before submitting. Do this one first, because DIR-3009 (The Manifest) is the same company and feeds off it. Not applicable to community, conference, coaching or SaaS properties.

targets.name: GoodFirms
targets.notes: Free company listing, registration via their own account subdomain. Their 2026 get-listed pitch is explicitly AI-search-visibility framed (claims positioning across GPT, Gemini, Perplexity), which lines up with the ai-seo-increase work, so this one has dual value. 10+ years, claims 160+ countries and 10M+ monthly users. Consulting/agency taxonomy only.

targets.name: The Manifest
targets.notes: Owned and operated by Clutch - homepage footer links to help.clutch.co/contact-the-manifest and the Clutch service-provider knowledge base. Do DIR-3007 (Clutch) first; the profile and reviews carry across, so treat this as a second surface rather than independent work. The get-listed path is Cloudflare bot-protected against automated fetch but is linked from their own live homepage footer, so submit in a real browser.

targets.name: Sortlist
targets.notes: Live 3-step flow: select/create company entity, add information, create a manager account. Note sortlist.com/signup is 404 - use /claim/agency. Free profile shows a MAXIMUM of 2 services publicly; Sortlist+ paid plan needed beyond that. Strong European skew, which suits a CZ-based s.r.o. Caveat from their own guidance: they do not usually work with self-employed providers or small businesses, average client project budget around EUR 37k - so pitch a services property as the company, not the owner as an individual.

targets.name: DesignRush
targets.notes: Note designrush.com/agency/get-listed is 404 - the live form is /submit/agency. Free account creation (name, email, phone, password). Editorial gate is explicit on the form: 'We only accept agencies that we consider to be legitimate and professional. We will review your submission based on your website, portfolio, online reputation and reviews.' So a services property needs a credible services site and visible client logos before submitting. Directory is design/dev/marketing-agency shaped, so position as technology leadership consulting rather than coaching.

targets.name: Agency Spotter
targets.notes: Multi-step signup, email or LinkedIn OAuth. Has a published /pricing page, so free profile with paid upgrade. Smaller and more US/brand-marketing-weighted than Clutch or Sortlist - treat as fill-in volume after the priority-1 and priority-2 agency directories are done, not as a lead source.

targets.name: TechBehemoths
targets.notes: IT-services-specific directory with decent European and CEE coverage, which fits a Czech s.r.o. Free listing. The submit path is Cloudflare bot-protected against automated fetch, but the URL is taken from TechBehemoths' own live site header ('Get Listed' link), so submit in a real browser. Closer to a services property's actual buyer than the design-agency directories.

targets.name: SourceForge / Slashdot Business Software
targets.notes: Slashdot Media operates SourceForge and Slashdot business-software listings - one submission surfaces on both. Free listing tier, paid demand-gen on top. Lower buyer quality than G2 or Capterra but almost zero effort, so worth doing once a marketplace property is past MVP. Requires a SourceForge account. Not a fit for consulting, community, conference or coaching properties.

targets.name: ADPList
targets.notes: Best fit: a personal-brand property. Live 2026 (© Copyright 2026 - ADPList), 38,812+ mentors across 140 countries, 40,000+ verified mentors in the public /mentors directory, 1M+ users. Every session is free to the mentee — mentors are unpaid, so this is a visibility/authority play, not revenue. Public mentor profile pages at adplist.org/mentors/{slug} are the linkable asset. Help-centre FAQ 'What's the approval criteria to be a mentor?' confirms a review gate exists. Engineering is a named category alongside AI, Design, Product, Marketing. Highest-volume mentoring surface in this block; also a plausible top-of-funnel feeder into a marketplace property.

targets.name: MentorCruise
targets.notes: Best fit: a personal-brand property. Free to list — no membership fee, no upfront cost ('We only get paid if you do!'). Revenue model is a 20% fee added on top of the mentor's own price; mentor keeps 80% and sets their own rate. Average mentor payout ~$500/mo, top mentors low four figures. Vetting is real but not extreme — 'We demand the highest quality service from our mentors', 97% satisfaction rate. This is the one target in the block that is simultaneously a listing, a backlink and a paid revenue channel, which is why it ranks alongside ADPList. Positioning angle: engineering-leadership mentoring at VP/CTO level is thinner here than IC-level software mentoring.

targets.name: GrowthMentor
targets.notes: Best fit: a personal-brand property. Live 2026. Hardest gate in the mentoring cluster and the reason it is worth doing: 'Under 5% of applicants make it in. Every mentor applied, got interviewed, and got checked before they were listed. Most get declined.' Application is free; ~85% of mentors are included in the mentee's membership rather than charging per call, so treat this as scarcity-signal + profile authority rather than income. Sister service GrowthExpert.io routes paid work. Skew is growth/marketing/product — engineering leadership is a genuine white space here, which makes acceptance more likely on differentiation grounds, not less.

targets.name: The Pragmatic Engineer — Coaches and Mentors for Engineering Managers
targets.notes: PRIMARY TARGET OF THIS BLOCK for a personal-brand property. Live and confirmed a curated list of coaches/mentors for engineering managers and leaders. No form and no email address on the page — the stated mechanism is 'Missing someone from these lists? Reply to this thread on Twitter - I update the list based on it.' So the play is direct contact with Gergely Orosz (X/Twitter thread reply, or newsletter reply), not a submission. DOCUMENTED GAP CONFIRMED: the list is heavily concentrated in Berlin (Lena Reinhard, Pat Kua, Raphaela Wrede), London, the US, with thin representation from Spain, Portugal, Israel, Singapore, South Africa. Central/Eastern Europe is effectively absent — Israel is the only entry in the broad CEE bucket. A Prague-based coach backed by a 3,100-member CEE engineering leadership community is the exact profile the list lacks. Pitch the region, not the credentials.

targets.name: LeadDev — Get Involved
targets.notes: Best fit: a personal-brand property (author bio page) then a community property. Live 2026 — conferences in New York (Sep 15-16 2026), Berlin (Nov 9-10 2026), London (Jun 28-29 2027). Four routes, all free and all editorially gated: become a published author (/get-involved/become-a-published-author-with-leaddev), become a speaker (/get-involved/become-a-leaddev-speaker), activity host (/get-involved/activity-hosts), workshop lead. IMPORTANT TIMING: at time of verification all 2026 speaker CFPs were CLOSED with deadlines passed, and workshop submissions were closed and 'reopening later this year' — so the article route is the only one actionable right now. Contributors get a named profile in the community directory, which is the durable listing asset. Contact hello@leaddev.com. Highest-authority engineering-leadership publication in this block.

targets.name: Sessionize (Speaker Directory + CFP hosting)
targets.notes: Dual-purpose and unusually high value for the effort. (1) SPEAKER PROFILE for the owner: 83,000 public speaker profiles in the directory, and the site states profiles 'will always be free' — includes a reservable vanity URL (sessionize.com/app/speaker/profile). Instant, free, permanent, and links out to a personal-brand property. (2) CFP HOSTING for a conference property: run the community call for speakers on Sessionize — Community event tier is FREE for qualifying community events, Professional event is $499 USD +tax single-event, bulk custom for 5+/year. Live 2026 (© 2016-2026 Web-ideja Ltd). Do the free speaker profile regardless of whether the community uses the CFP product.

targets.name: CTO Craft
targets.notes: Best fit: a personal-brand property, secondary a services property. Live 2026 — CTO Craft Con: Europe (Sep 29-30 2026), CTO Craft Conversations: Stockholm (Oct 15 2026). Offers community/Slack, 'Campus' learning resource, mentoring circles for emerging CTOs, and 1:1 coaching. NO public 'become a coach' application page — the ~40+ listed coaches each have individually linked profiles, and entry is via direct contact through the general contact form. Coaching is delivered by 'experienced former CTOs from businesses like Made.com, Secret Sales, MyDeco, Photobox, Graze'. COMPETITIVE/POSITIONING ANGLE: roster is UK/Western-Europe dominated, same CEE blind spot as the Pragmatic Engineer list. Also a partnership target rather than purely a listing — the community and CTO Craft are structurally similar orgs in non-overlapping geographies, so a coach-roster listing and an event cross-promo are the same conversation.

targets.name: Go Fractional
targets.notes: Best fit: a services property (fractional CTO/VPE positioning). Live and expanding in 2026 — publicly launched its Fractional Job Board. Network of 15,000+ leaders, browsable by function, CTO is a core category. Self-described as 'picky' and deliberately not the largest network; average twelve years experience, each candidate verified by a dedicated executive recruiter on track record, references and hands-on leadership before being presented. Executives set their own rate; Go Fractional handles contracting and billing back-office. Note: homepage and /signup both return 403 to automated fetches — verified via search surfacing their own 2026 pages, so expect to complete signup in a real browser. Talent-side application cost not explicitly confirmed as free; confirm on the signup page.

targets.name: dev.events
targets.notes: Best fit: a conference property. Live and well-maintained — 1,304 conferences listed for 2026/2027. Submission is via the 'new event' button at the bottom right of the site (no separate submit URL); free. Approval: 'Our team will review the event and approve it within three working days if it meets the eligibility criteria.' Eligibility: must be tech/software/product focused, must clearly display date, location and registration link on your own site, and must include speaker information for verification — so publish the community speaker lineup before submitting. HIGH-VALUE MECHANIC: once listed, dev.events auto-monitors your site via JSON-LD structured metadata and notifies moderators of new editions for approval. Add Event JSON-LD to a conference property and future years get picked up automatically — one submission, recurring listing.

targets.name: confs.tech
targets.notes: Best fit: a conference property. Open-source and active — backed by github.com/tech-conferences/conference-data with 13,953 commits. Two submission routes: the web form at confs.tech/conferences/new, or a direct pull request against the topic/year JSON files in the repo. Free either way; PR review is the approval gate. Conference records carry name, url, dates, location, CFP details and social handles — so the CFP fields let you list the community call for speakers alongside the event itself. The PR route is worth preferring: it is a public, permanent, indexed GitHub artifact in addition to the site listing. LIVE-VERIFIED: submission form has a visible reCAPTCHA gating final submit (not detectable via text-only fetch, only found via browser render). Per Law 5, this is a hard-stop -- queue OWNER-ONLY for this target going forward, do not attempt agent auto-submission.

targets.name: developers.events
targets.notes: Best fit: a conference property. 'A community-driven platform listing developer/tech conferences and Calls for Papers (CFPs) worldwide.' Live and actively maintained — 3,698 commits, 4 open PRs, 9 open issues at time of check. Submission is GitHub-native: pull request against the data files (repo carries METADATA.csv / TAGS.csv), per CONTRIBUTING.md. Free. Lists CFPs as a first-class entity, so submit both the community event and its call for speakers. Same reasoning as confs.tech — the merged PR is itself a durable public artifact. Note the site homepage renders almost nothing to automated fetchers; verification was done against the source repo.

targets.name: Meetup
targets.notes: Best fit: a community property — the monthly Prague/CEE meetup cadence is exactly this platform's use case, and a Meetup group is a persistent community listing, not a one-off event post. Live 2026 (events listed through August 2026). Membership is free for attendees; ORGANIZING is a paid subscription — the homepage does not quote it, and secondary sources put the standard organizer plan around $14.99/mo for a group up to 50 members, tiered upward by size. Verify current pricing at checkout before committing. Start a group: meetup.com/start (also /how-to-group-start/). The group page is the linkable asset and it ranks; the individual event posts are secondary.

targets.name: Eventbrite
targets.notes: Best fit: a conference property. Live 2026 (© 2026 Eventbrite). 'Easily create events for free on a platform that attendees love and trust' — free event creation, with ticketing fees applying to paid tickets (pricing tiers not detailed on the organizer overview page; check /organizer/pricing if the community sells tickets here). The durable listing asset is the ORGANIZER PROFILE page, which aggregates all past and future the community editions and meetups under one indexed URL — set that up properly rather than treating each event as standalone. Lower priority than Meetup for a community property since the community cadence lives better on Meetup, but Eventbrite is the stronger surface for a paid annual conference.

targets.name: Podchaser
targets.notes: Best fit: a personal-brand property. Live 2026 — 2026 copyright, published a 'Top 25 New Podcasts – May 2026' list, status page operational; acquired by Acast in Aug 2022, UI overhauled in 2026. Three page types: user account, podcast page, creator profile. The play for the owner is a CREATOR PROFILE with GUEST credits attached to every podcast appearance — claim an existing auto-generated profile via the Claim Profile button, or create one with bio and headshot. Add credits via account image > My Stuff > My Creators > settings wheel > Podcast Credits > Add Credits, selecting podcast, episodes and role (Host/Guest/Producer/Editor). All new credits and profiles are moderated, up to 24h for approval. Free. Podchaser's API underpins many third-party podcast discovery tools, so the profile propagates well beyond the site itself. Note: podchaser.com 403s automated fetches — verified via their help centre and 2026 published lists.

targets.name: Toptal
targets.notes: Best fit: a services property. Live 2026 (2026 rankings and copyright on site). Recruits beyond developers — Product Managers, Project Managers, and Management/Finance/Strategy Consultants are all named categories, which is the route in for a fractional CTO/VPE profile. Screening is the well-known multi-stage gauntlet; site claims a 98% trial-to-hire success rate off the back of it ('Every applicant to the Toptal network is rigorously tested and vetted'). Free to apply. Ranked priority 3 not because it is weak but because it is a high-effort, high-rejection, low-SEO-yield application — the profile sits behind their marketplace rather than producing a strong public linkable page. Do it only if a services property actively wants inbound fractional deal flow.

targets.name: ICF Credentialed Coach Finder
targets.notes: Best fit: a personal-brand property. Directory verified live and functional — filters by credential (ACC/PCC/MCC), coaching theme, method, experience, demographics, languages and location. HARD GATE, note carefully: 'CCF lists ICF credential-holders who are also members of ICF' — you need BOTH an active ICF credential AND current ICF membership. ACC needs 60+ hrs training and 100+ coaching hours; PCC 125+ and 500+; MCC requires PCC plus 200+ and 2,500+. Credential renews every 3 years, membership annually. There is no extra fee for the listing itself — it comes with membership — and ICF sells an optional paid 'enhanced listing' upgrade. Only actionable if the owner already holds or intends to pursue an ICF credential; if not, skip. Listed at priority 2 because it is the single most recognised coaching directory worldwide, so it is worth a deliberate yes/no decision rather than silent omission.

targets.name: PaperCall.io
targets.notes: Best fit: a conference property. Live 2026 (© 2026 PaperCall.io). CFP management, free tier prominent — 'Easier CFP Management for FREE', 'Launch your fully featured CFP in just a few minutes. No more Google Forms!' Includes customizable event landing pages, automatic CFP open/close, one-click speaker submissions. Speakers also maintain talk profiles on the platform. A pricing page exists at /pricing for higher tiers. Priority 3 because it overlaps heavily with Sessionize (DIR-4006) — pick one CFP platform for the community rather than both; Sessionize has the larger speaker directory and therefore the better discovery side. Worth listing here as the fallback if Sessionize's community-event free tier does not qualify the community.

targets.name: 10times
targets.notes: Best fit: a conference property. Organizer portal at login.10times.com; sign up with a business email, then 'Add event' (top left of dashboard). CHECK FIRST whether the community is already auto-aggregated — 10times scrapes events, and if a listing exists you CLAIM it rather than create a duplicate; only representatives, employees or owners may claim, and claiming unlocks editing, users, leads, content, marketing and analytics, plus an org-level business profile covering all editions. Free listing, no credit card, does not expire, typically indexed by Google within 24-48h; the paid gate is lead contact details (email/phone locked on Free) and featured placement. Pricing at login.10times.com/plans, claim guide at help.10times.com. Priority 3 — broad B2B trade-show audience, weak fit with an engineering-leadership crowd, but cheap and it does rank.

targets.name: Listen Notes
targets.notes: Best fit: a personal-brand property. Podcast database of 3.7M+ podcasts and 191M+ episodes, self-described as 'the most popular podcast search engine on the Internet', with an API that feeds third-party apps. Submission takes an Apple Podcasts URL or RSS feed, free, no login apparent — but note their own caveat: 'It is very likely that your podcast is already in our database' and 'Any podcasts that are publicly accessible on the Internet will eventually be added' — so submission is mostly a no-op accelerator. The genuinely useful feature for the owner is person-level indexing: 'Listeners find ALL podcast episodes interviewing or talking about a person. Journalists do research and find information in podcasts.' Priority 3 as a submission target; higher value as a monitoring surface for guest appearances. Contact hello@listennotes.com.

targets.name: PodMatch
targets.cost: paid:monthly subscription (Standard/Professional Guest tiers; price not rendered on fetched page)
targets.notes: Best fit: a personal-brand property. Guest-to-host matchmaking. Guests build a 'media one-sheet' profile that is shareable with non-members, and the Standard tier explicitly includes a 'Public Guest One Sheet for SEO and Sharing' plus unlimited access to the host Explore page — the public one-sheet is the listing asset. Two paid guest tiers (Standard, Professional); the price figures did not render in the fetched content, so confirm current cost before subscribing — this is the only target in the block with an unresolved price. No approval process mentioned. Priority 3: it is a genuine outbound podcast-booking engine rather than a directory, so justify it on booked appearances, not on the listing.

targets.name: EMCC Global
targets.notes: Best fit: a personal-brand property. Live 2026 — running a 2026-2027 EMCC Global Research Competition with a deadline. The European counterpart to ICF (DIR-4016) and the more natural fit for a Prague-based coach. Relevant accreditation is EIA (EMCC Global Individual Accreditation) for coaches and mentors, awarded at Foundation, Practitioner, Senior and Master Practitioner levels; related tracks are ESIA (supervision), ITCA (team coaching), IPMA (programme management). Homepage nav carries 'Find an accredited coach, supervisor or training provider', confirming a public directory of accredited practitioners. CAVEAT: the deep directory URL could not be resolved — the homepage nav link itself resolved to a /404-2/ path and my direct attempt 404'd, so navigate from the homepage rather than trusting a saved URL. Member portal at emccglobal.member365.com. Same decision logic as ICF: only worth it if pursuing formal coaching accreditation.

targets.name: Fractional Jobs
targets.notes: Best fit: a services property. Live 2026 — job postings dated through August 2026. Lowest-friction target in the whole block: joining the talent network is just picking a function (Engineering is a listed category, alongside Product, Design, Sales, Finance, Ops, Growth, People, Analytics) and adding an email on the home page — no profile creation, no approval gate, free. They state 'We pre-screen all candidates for you' on the company side, so some evaluation happens later. Platform promises: '100% guarantee that your intro request will be seen' and a response within 14 days on featured roles. Priority 3 — five minutes of effort, no public profile page and therefore no listing/SEO value; justify purely as fractional deal flow. Contact hello@fractionaljobs.io.

targets.name: Torch (Torch Leadership Labs)
targets.notes: Best fit: a personal-brand property. VERIFIED ALIVE but effectively CLOSED right now — include for tracking, do not spend effort yet. Live 2026 (© 2026 Torch Leadership Labs, blog posts Feb 2026); B2B SaaS coaching platform for mid-market/enterprise, now pairing human coaches with their 'Spark AI agent'. The /be-a-coach/ page states plainly: 'While we're not currently onboarding new coaches, be first in line when opportunities open up.' No form — applications go by email to coachoperations@torch.io. STEEP CREDENTIAL BAR even when open: Bachelor's minimum (Master's+ for executive coaches), ACC credential required or international equivalent (PCC for executive roles), 5+ years business/leadership experience (15+ for executive), 300+ coaching hours (750+ for executive). Priority 3 — gated on both a closed door and an ICF credential the owner would need to hold first (see DIR-4016).

targets.name: Firmy.cz (Seznam)
targets.notes: THE single most important CZ listing. 750,000+ verified companies; a Firmy.cz record feeds Mapy.cz, Seznam.cz search and Seznam's wider surfaces — footer states 'Přidejte ji a objevíte se nejen na Firmách, ale i Mapách, Seznamu a celém internetu.' GENUINE MANUAL SUBMISSION, not ARES auto-population — the catalog is user/operator-built, so no stub record exists to claim; you create it. Requires a Seznam.cz account. Registration is explicitly free ('Registrace je zdarma a zabere jen pár minut'). LOCALIZE GATE: HARD BLOCKER for a community property and a personal-brand property — Firmy.cz is a Czech-language catalog serving Czech-language searchers, and pointing a listing at an English-only site wastes the highest-value CZ placement available. Ship the CZ page set for those two before submitting. a services property (the operating company, your company registration number) and a local-language app property (CZ-native) can be submitted immediately. Submit a services property under the s.r.o. legal identity; a single IČO can carry multiple provozovny/websites if the streams need separate records.

targets.name: Zlaté stránky (zlatestranky.cz)
targets.notes: 823,263 company profiles, operated by Mediatel. Basic listing explicitly free ('Přidat firmu do Zlatých stránek zcela zdarma'), managed through the MojeFirma dashboard; paid tiers and printed Yellow Pages exist as upsells. MIXED POPULATION MODEL — the 823k figure is far larger than any voluntarily-submitted catalog, so a stub record seeded from register data may already exist for your company registration number. CHECK FIRST, then claim/correct rather than creating a duplicate; only submit fresh if no record is found. Expect a sales call after registering. LOCALIZE GATE: Czech-language catalog — restrict to a services property and a local-language app property until CZ pages exist for the other properties.

targets.name: Najisto.cz (Centrum.cz)
targets.notes: Centrum.cz's 'katalog ověřených firem'. Navigation carries an explicit 'Přidat firmu zdarma' CTA. GENUINE MANUAL SUBMISSION — no evidence of ARES auto-population; existing records are managed through a separate business login at admin-najisto.centrum.cz/prihlaseni/. Note the apex www.najisto.cz returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients; the working host is najisto.centrum.cz — use that, not the apex. Second-tier reach behind Seznam but free and low-effort. LOCALIZE GATE: Czech-language catalog — a services property and a local-language app property only until CZ pages ship elsewhere.

targets.name: Živéfirmy.cz
targets.notes: Self-described 'largest independent catalog of Czech companies'. Free submission accepts just a company name, website OR IČO — 'Rádi ji ZDARMA přidáme', processed within three business days. MIXED MODEL, LEANS AUTO-POPULATED: the site reports 41,286 firms added in the past year and 20,058 records corrected last month, which is operator-side bulk maintenance, not user submissions — so CHECK FOR AN EXISTING RECORD under your company registration number before submitting and correct it if present. Free tier is a basic listing; paid 'Balíček služeb' adds galleries and insolvency monitoring — not needed. LOCALIZE GATE: CZ-language catalog, restrict to a services property and a local-language app property for now.

targets.name: Evropská databanka (EDB)
targets.notes: 690,000+ companies, CZ and SK coverage, operated by Evropská databanka s.r.o. (Brno). Free listing explicitly confirmed on the submission page ('Přidejte se zdarma'); the free record includes a backlink to the company website and can be translated into 7 languages (EN, DE, SK, IT, PL, ES, UK) — the multilingual angle is unusually useful for a services property, since it lets an English-language target page sit behind a Czech-catalog record without a full CZ site. GENUINE MANUAL SUBMISSION — no IČO auto-fill observed on the form. Note the direct form at edb.cz/PridatZaznam.aspx returns 403 to non-browser clients; the evropska-databanka.cz/vlozit-firmu/ route works. Expect an upsell call (přednostní zápisy, PR articles, PPC) after submitting — decline. LOCALIZE GATE: partially bypassed thanks to the translation feature, but the record itself is CZ-first.

targets.name: Hospodářská komora ČR
targets.notes: The Czech Chamber of Commerce. Membership is voluntary and open to any legal or natural person with a Czech trade licence and a registered seat in ČR — the operating company qualifies. GENUINE APPLICATION, NOT AUTO-POPULATED: you join through a district/regional chamber or an affiliated trade association, submitting a scanned 'žádost o začlenění' by email (vnitrnikomunikace@komora.cz for the national body; regional chambers take applications directly). Fees are set per chamber by headcount — 500 CZK/yr for a natural person, 5,000 CZK/yr for a legal entity via a district/regional chamber under the Příspěvkový řád; komora.cz's own recommended scale starts at 1,500 CZK/yr for a member with no employees. Approved by the chamber's board. Note komora.cz returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients — verified via search rather than direct fetch. STRATEGIC ANGLE: ČAUI (DIR-5012) is a formal component of HK ČR, so joining ČAUI carries chamber affiliation with more relevant positioning for less friction. No localize gate on the application itself, but any member-facing profile will be Czech-language.

targets.name: Svaz průmyslu a dopravy ČR
targets.notes: Self-described 'nejvlivnější byznysový svaz v Česku'. Live, Czech-language, with a 'Staňte se členem' CTA and a /vyhody-clenstvi benefits page. GENUINE APPLICATION — not auto-populated. NO PUBLIC MEMBER DIRECTORY was found on the site, which removes most of the listing value for this skill's purposes; fees are not published and require contacting spcr@spcr.cz. LOW FIT: the association skews heavily toward industrial manufacturers and transport, not a 12-person leadership-consulting s.r.o. Treat as a relationship/credibility play rather than a listing, and only if an existing client relationship makes the room worth being in. No localize gate — but all interaction is Czech-language.

targets.name: ICT Unie
targets.notes: 'Profesní sdružení firem z oboru IT informačních technologií a elektronických komunikací' — the closest institutional fit in this block for an engineering-leadership consultancy. HAS A PUBLIC MEMBER DIRECTORY ('Členové ICT UNIE', ~60+ member organisation logos), which is what makes it worth the fee: a real listing on a relevant.cz industry body. GENUINE APPLICATION, NOT AUTO-POPULATED — entry points are 'Proč se stát členem' and 'Chci se zapojit' CTAs; note /clenstvi/ returns 404, so navigate from the homepage rather than guessing the path. Fees are not published — contact required. Site offers a Czech and an English version. LOCALIZE GATE: SOFT — the member directory entry is a logo plus link, so an English-only a services property can be listed without CZ pages existing first. Best cost/benefit of the six CZ institutions here.

targets.name: American Chamber of Commerce in the Czech Republic (AmCham CZ)
targets.notes: PUBLIC MEMBERSHIP DIRECTORY at /membership-directory/corporate plus a separate 'Czech Marketplace' resource for members — a genuine listing, not just a badge. GENUINE APPLICATION via an online form ('APPLY NOW'); contacts Barbora Vítová / Gabriela Rybová for assistance. Fees published: Corporate 65,000 CZK/yr, Small Business/Entrepreneur 25,000 CZK/yr for companies under 40M CZK annual turnover (the applicable tier for the operating company), Corporate Patron 200,000 CZK/2yr. Membership year runs July–June with pro-rated mid-year joining — joining now means a partial first year. NOT AUTO-POPULATED. LOCALIZE GATE: FULLY BYPASSED — AmCham operates primarily in English, so a community property, a conference property and a services property can all be represented as-is with no CZ pages required. That makes this the only paid CZ institution in this block that works today without localization. Also the strongest event/sponsorship adjacency for a conference property.

targets.name: CACIO (Czech Association of Chief Information Officers)
targets.notes: Active Czech association of IT managers/CIOs (site copyright 2026, entirely Czech). Navigation carries 'Přijímání nových členů' so membership is open. GENUINE APPLICATION, NOT AUTO-POPULATED — contact tajemnik@cacio.cz; neither procedure nor fees are published. NO PUBLIC MEMBER DIRECTORY was found (only a 'Řídící výbor' board page), so the listing value is weak — this is an audience-access play, not a listing. AUDIENCE FIT IS EXCELLENT though: CACIO's membership is exactly the CIO/IT-director population a community property and a services property sell to, so it may be worth more as a speaking/partnership route than as a directory entry. Consider handing to /founder-pipeline:web-backlinks or partnership outreach rather than treating as a register-once listing. LOCALIZE GATE: Czech-language body — expect Czech-language interaction throughout.

targets.name: Česká asociace umělé inteligence (ČAUI)
targets.notes: The relevant CZ AI/digital industry association — founded 2023, 400+ corporate members, a formal component of Hospodářská komora ČR and a member of the US Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence. PUBLIC MEMBER DIRECTORY at /clenove/ carrying Google, Microsoft, Accenture, Vodafone and Škoda Auto logos — a genuinely strong logo wall to appear on. GENUINE APPLICATION at /zadost/, NOT AUTO-POPULATED. Published tiers: Basic 9,000 CZK/yr (7,200 with a 2-year commit) explicitly aimed at freelancers and small businesses — the right tier for the operating company; Premium 23,500 CZK/yr; Enterprise on request. Also runs the AI EKOSYSTÉM magazine, the mesic.ai conference festival and working groups — real speaking and co-marketing surface for a conference property adjacency. NOTE: joining ČAUI also delivers HK ČR affiliation (DIR-5007) at lower friction and with far better positioning. LOCALIZE GATE: SOFT — directory entry is a logo plus link, so no CZ page set is strictly required, but Czech-language member communications should be expected. Best strategic fit of the CZ institutions.

targets.name: Atmoskop
targets.notes: Live Czech employer-review platform ('ověřená hodnocení firem od zaměstnanců') — the CZ equivalent of Glassdoor, operated in the LMC/Jobs.cz orbit. NO SELF-SERVE COMPANY REGISTRATION FOUND: both /pro-firmy and /pro-zamestnavatele return 404, and the only employer route surfaced is sales-led via +420 224 810 055 / pomuzeme@atmoskop.cz. Company profiles appear to be platform-generated from employee reviews and job data rather than submitted, so the realistic action is CLAIM-AND-CORRECT if a record exists, not fresh submission. Free browsing; paid 'placené služby' premium employer presentation exists. POOR FIT: the operating company is too small to have a meaningful review footprint, and none of the seven properties is an employer brand seeking candidates — this is a target for a hiring company, which these are not. applies_to intentionally empty; revisit only if ELH starts hiring in CZ at scale.

targets.name: StartupJobs.cz
targets.notes: Czech job board for technology and innovative companies, plus the catalogue that powers StartupMap.cz (DIR-5017). Company registration form verified live at /admin/startup/pridat — requires company name, contact name, email, phone, password and T&C acceptance, i.e. ACCOUNT CREATION REQUIRED. GENUINE MANUAL SUBMISSION, not auto-populated. CRITICAL CATCH: creating the company profile is NOT sufficient to appear in the public catalogue — 'Profil firmy je v seznamu firem zveřejněn spolu se schválením prvního inzerátu', so the profile only publishes once a first job ad is approved. Free ads are restricted to companies using StartupJobs' own career-pages product; otherwise paid (HotJobs 2,999 CZK/14 days or 4,999 CZK/30 days; base ad pricing on /pro-firmy/cenik). NO MENTOR, COACH OR ADVISOR SECTION EXISTS — I checked; it is a jobs-only platform, so it does nothing for a personal-brand property or a marketplace property. Only worth it if a services property has a genuine role to advertise. LOCALIZE GATE: Czech-language platform.

targets.name: Cocuma
targets.notes: SKIP ON COST — verified live with a public company directory at /list/ and CZ/SK/global versions, but pricing puts it far outside any reasonable listing budget. Published tiers: size S (up to 50 employees) 95,000 CZK initial + 57,000 CZK annual renewal; M 160,000 + 96,000; L 250,000 + 150,000; XL from 350,000. NO FREE TIER EXISTS — all packages are paid. GENUINE EDITORIAL PRODUCTION, not auto-populated: Cocuma interviews owners and produces a bespoke employer-brand profile ('We prefer working directly with owners who want to showcase their company atmosphere'), which is why it costs what it does. Sales-led signup only, through a named contact on the vendor's own contact page — no self-service. This is an employer-branding product for companies hiring at volume, which most single-brand properties are not. applies_to intentionally empty. Recorded here so it is not re-researched.

targets.name: CzechStartups.gov.cz (CzechInvest)
targets.notes: Verified live (CZ and EN) — the official CzechInvest startup portal, launched 2015 with IBM, Czech ICT Alliance, AMSP and Rockaway; a.gov.cz domain, so the authority would be excellent. BUT NO OPEN SUBMISSION MECHANISM EXISTS: the /en/startup-ecosystem/start-ups/ page is EDITORIALLY CURATED ('selected successful Czech startups' — Gen Digital, Twisto, Liftago, STRV) with no form, no criteria published and no self-submission route; the startup-data section is PowerBI dashboards, not a registerable database. The homepage carries a 'Chci do databáze nahlédnout nebo se stát její součástí' entry point to a startups/investors/infrastructure database, but no working registration URL surfaced from either fetch or search. NOT AUTO-POPULATED and not self-submittable. ALSO A FIT PROBLEM: none of the seven properties is a venture-backed startup — they are a community, a conference, a consultancy and marketplaces — so inclusion would be a stretch even with a form. ACTION: contact CzechInvest's startup department directly if the.gov.cz link is judged worth chasing; otherwise deprioritise and use StartupMap.cz (DIR-5017) as the practical CZ startup-map route. applies_to intentionally empty.

targets.name: ICF Czech Republic (International Coaching Federation, Czech Charter Chapter)
targets.notes: TOP-TIER TARGET FOR a personal-brand property. Verified live, bilingual CZ/EN. Runs a PUBLIC COACH REGISTRY — 'Registr koučů', reachable via the 'FIND A COACH' navigation — positioned as 'Najděte profesionálního kouče/ku pro potřeby vašeho rozvoje', i.e. a high-intent discovery surface exactly matching a personal-brand property's 1:1 leadership mentoring offer. GENUINE APPLICATION, NOT AUTO-POPULATED. IMPORTANT PREREQUISITE: the chapter frames listed coaches around ICF credentials (ACC/PCC/MCC) and stresses that 'Every person can call themselves a coach' whereas ICF-certified coaches have met strict education and experience requirements — so CONFIRM whether the owner holds or intends to pursue an ICF credential before pursuing this; chapter membership and international certification are separate, and the registry may be credential-gated. Fees are not published on the homepage. Deep-link paths are unstable (both /cz/registr-koucu.html and the /en/ variant 404 or redirect cross-host) — navigate from the homepage. LOCALIZE GATE: the registry serves Czech-language seekers, so a CZ version of a personal-brand property materially raises the value of the listing, though the registry profile itself lives on coachfederation.cz and can be published before a personal-brand property is localized. Pair with EMCC (DIR-5022) — together they are the two credible CZ coaching bodies.

targets.name: EMCC Czechia & Slovakia (successor to Česká asociace koučů / ČAKO)
targets.notes: TOP-TIER TARGET FOR a personal-brand property — and the correction to a stale assumption: ČESKÁ ASOCIACE KOUČŮ (ČAKO) NO LONGER EXISTS AS A SEPARATE BODY. ČAKO (founded 2004) merged with EMCC Czech Republic and continues under the EMCC name; the region then expanded to cover both Czechia and Slovakia. Do not chase cako.cz or a standalone ČAKO listing — this is the successor. PUBLIC COACH DIRECTORY: 'Profily koučů – členů EMCC CZSK' plus a listing of EIA-accredited coaches and mentors, and the membership page has an explicit 'Vytvoření profilu kouče' step, so a member profile is a genuine listing outcome. LOW BARRIER TO ENTRY, unlike ICF: 'Členem EMCC se může stát každý, kdo se zajímá o mentoring a koučování' — no prior credential required, which makes this the faster of the two coaching bodies to land. Fee published: 3,900 CZK/yr (~350 CZK/month) or 160 EUR for full membership rights. GENUINE APPLICATION via an online Google Form linked from /clenstvi/ (use the /clenstvi/ page rather than the raw form URL, which will rot). MENTORING ANGLE: EMCC explicitly covers mentoring as well as coaching, which is why a marketplace property is included — worth checking whether the marketplace can be represented alongside the owner's individual profile. TERRITORY NOTE: single membership covers both CZ and SK, useful given the Bratislava chapter. LOCALIZE GATE: Czech-language body and directory — a CZ version of a personal-brand property would convert far better from this listing, but the profile can be created first. RECOMMENDED FIRST MOVE of the whole coaching sub-block: cheapest, no credential gate, real public profile.

targets.name: Azet Katalóg (azet.sk)
targets.notes: HARD PREREQUISITE: a Slovak company registration number. Confirm with the owner whether a Slovak entity or branch exists, and get the exact number from them at submission time rather than guessing one -- a Czech number will not pass step 1. Re-verified live: no website-only workaround exists here (unlike Zoznam.sk, DIR-0078) -- the form is genuinely IČO-gated with no alternative route, so the correct Slovak IČO is a hard prerequisite to submit. The leading Slovak business catalog — 183,000+ companies, 'Pridajte sa aj vy do najväčšieho katalógu firiem'. Submission form verified live at /katalog/pridat/firma/. HYBRID MECHANISM — this is the key detail: the multi-step flow BEGINS WITH AN IČO LOOKUP against the Slovak register (step 1 IČO verification, step 2 profile selection, step 3 company details), so the record is register-assisted but you must still submit it. Existing companies enter a password to manage an existing listing, and an edit route exists at /katalog/editovat/firma/ — so CHECK FOR AN EXISTING RECORD BEFORE CREATING ONE. Basic listing appears free with 'Platený profil' as a separate paid upgrade. HARD BLOCKER for a foreign operator: the ID-first flow expects a SLOVAK identification number, so a portfolio whose only legal entity is Czech will fail at step 1. This is the general shape of the problem in several markets — a local company-registration gate on the generic business-catalog tier. LOCALIZE GATE: compounding problem — Slovak-language catalog, so a property with no Slovak pages fails Law 4 as well. Resolve the entity question first, localization second.

targets.name: Zoznam.sk katalóg
targets.notes: The company route ('Pridať firmu') is viable only with a Slovak entity; without one, the website route below is the workaround. Slovak portal ('Zoznam slovenského internetu') with a live business catalog at /katalog/. TWO DISTINCT SUBMISSION ROUTES, and the distinction matters: 'Pridať firmu' (company record, at /firma — 'Prezentujte svoju firmu na stránkach Zoznamu') AND 'Pridať stránku' (website submission). THE WEBSITE ROUTE IS THE WORKAROUND FOR THE SLOVAK-ENTITY PROBLEM that blocks Azet (DIR-5023): submitting a website does not require a Slovak IČO, so a property with genuine local relevance (a local chapter, a regionally-relevant event) can plausibly be listed without a Slovak legal entity. GENUINE MANUAL SUBMISSION, not auto-populated. Pricing is not stated on the catalog page and a 'Prihlásenie' login exists, so assume account creation and verify cost at submission time. LOCALIZE GATE: SOFT for the website route — a Slovak-language landing page (or at minimum a Bratislava chapter page) would substantially improve both acceptance odds and conversion, but is not a hard prerequisite the way it is for the CZ business catalogs. BEST SLOVAK ENTRY POINT of the four SK targets here — try this before Azet.

targets.name: Zlaté stránky SK (zlatestranky.sk)
targets.notes: Requires a Slovak company registration number, same gate as the two SK siblings. Slovak counterpart to DIR-5002 — 'Zlaté stránky - online databáza firiem', live and Slovak-language, with a verified 'Pridať firmu' route at /pridat-firmu/ and the promise 'Svoju firmu pridáte jednoducho a rýchlo'. Runs alongside printed Yellow Pages ('Tlačené Zlaté stránky') and an advertising business, so paid premium tiers exist; the page does not state whether the basic listing is free — VERIFY COST AT SUBMISSION. Login requirement not stated. GENUINE MANUAL SUBMISSION as far as could be verified, though as with the CZ sibling a register-seeded stub may already exist — check before creating. Phone 02/501 02 888. LOCALIZE GATE: Slovak-language catalog and no property has SK pages -- soft gate, not a hard prerequisite (Law 4 nuance, see entity-pack.md).

targets.name: Crossweb
targets.notes: Poland's IT/startup event base. VERIFIED LIVE via Firecrawl (403s plain fetchers behind Cloudflare - use a real browser or Firecrawl, not WebFetch). Submit page states 'Aby dodac nowe wydarzenie do Crossweb, potrzebujesz konta' - free account at /rejestracja/ (email or Facebook). TWO PUBLISH PATHS: (a) submit via form, wait for editor approval; (b) email the editorial team to be granted the 'organizator wydarzenia' / 'organizator cyklu' role, then self-publish instantly. The CYCLE role is the correct one for a recurring meetup in Kraków - one human step (the email) unlocks permanent self-publishing. ENTITY GATE: none - no NIP, no Polish legal entity. LANGUAGE GATE: DOES NOT BLOCK - title/description are typed into Crossweb's own form and the website field accepts an English URL with no language validation; write Polish copy for quality, not eligibility. LINK-BACK: no reciprocal-link clause found. Covers Krakow, Warszawa, Wroclaw, Trojmiasto, Poznan, Katowice, Lodz and online.

targets.name: EMCC Poland (European Mentoring and Coaching Council Poland)
targets.notes: Cleanest PL win for the person entity. VERIFIED LIVE: /dolacz-do-nas/ (200) and the public directory /members (200, populated, incl. Krakow-based members). The 'czlonek zwyczajny' tier explicitly lists 'Personal branding: wizytowka na stronie EMCC Poland w zakladce Znajdz mentora, coacha, superwizora'. ENTITY GATE: NONE - individual membership, so the Czech operating company is irrelevant (this is why it beats every PL institution target). Directory filters by city, accreditation type (EIA/ESIA/ITCA/IPMA), level, and LANGUAGE - Polish AND English both selectable; members appear without accreditation badges, so EIA accreditation looks optional for listing (accreditation is what makes it credible, not what admits you). LANGUAGE GATE: DOES NOT BLOCK - profile authored on emccpoland.org; write a Polish bio, outbound link to an English a personal-brand property is fine. Registration runs through an external system (emcc.sorga.pl). No link-back requirement. Sibling of DIR-0076 (EMCC Czechia & Slovakia) - separate national chapter, separate membership.

targets.name: Informator Konferencyjny
targets.cost: free per the site's own organizer copy - UNVERIFIED: no explicit '0 zl' renders on the form page itself
targets.notes: The one Polish conference calendar with a real commercial-tech taxonomy. VERIFIED LIVE: full submission form renders (200), NO ACCOUNT NEEDED. Required fields: event name, start/end dates, topic, organizer name, submitter name + email, description, participation fee. Optional: venue, event website URL, 1200x630 logo/banner. Topic taxonomy includes 'technologiczna / IT' AND 'biznesowa' - a genuine fit, unlike the academic-only Polish calendars (cf. Swiat Konferencji, rejected: its taxonomy is academic disciplines and listings are overwhelmingly 'ogolnopolska konferencja naukowa'). Operated by CONREGO Sp. z o.o. (KRS 0000716221). ENTITY GATE: none. LANGUAGE GATE: does not block - description typed into their form, website field takes any URL. LINK-BACK: none found.

targets.name: OMGKRK - Krakow Startup Community
targets.notes: Relationship play, not a form-fill. VERIFIED LIVE: homepage, /membership-network/ and /krakow-startup-map/ all 200. Runs the Krakow Startups Database (Airtable-embedded map), a vetted Membership Network, and recurring formats (Hangouts, Investor Salons, Summer Jam). NO public submission form - the page says organizations are 'carefully vetted by the Foundation' and routes to a Calendly call; database inclusion also goes via direct contact. ENTITY GATE: not stated, criteria unpublished - UNVERIFIED. LANGUAGE GATE: does not block, the entire site operates in English. Strong strategic fit because a community property already runs Krakow meetups; the realistic ask is co-listing or partnership rather than a directory row.

targets.name: Evenea

targets.notes: VERIFIED LIVE: homepage and /produkty/cennik both 200; catalog actively populated with 2026 events. Organizer account required; events self-publish (instant). ENTITY GATE: none for listing; a Polish billing entity may matter only if selling tickets through their payment rail - UNVERIFIED. LANGUAGE GATE: does not block - you author the event page on Evenea; write Polish, link out to English.

targets.name: Europe Startup Guide
targets.notes: Best find of the Europe pass. Open pan-European directory: 3,217 organisations / 777 events across 53 countries, data last refreshed (actively maintained, not a zombie). /suggest is genuinely self-serve - NO ACCOUNT, no fee, human review before publish. Type dropdown includes 'Support Organization', 'Innovation Hub', 'Event Organisator', 'Event', 'Startup': a community property fits as Support Organization or Innovation Hub, a conference property warrants TWO submissions (Event + Event Organisator), a talent-network property as Startup. Country list includes Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland. Fields: name, type, country, city, website, description (40-7000 chars), sectors, key people, related entities, source links, submitter name + email. LINK-BACK: a 'Featured on Europe Startup Guide' badge exists at /link-to-us with followed embed code, but it is explicitly an OPTIONAL courtesy for listed entities, NOT a condition of listing - nothing in the submission flow requires it, so this does not trip Law 1. targets.name: EU Digital Skills and Jobs Platform (Digital Skills & Jobs Coalition)
targets.notes: Highest-authority entity surface available to a Czech engineering-leadership org anywhere in this sweep, and free. European Commission platform (CEF-funded) on a europa.eu domain. FLOW: EU Login account -> manual account approval (a few working days; a 'blocked account' notice just means pending, not rejected) -> register an Organisation, which appears in the public directory at /en/community/networking/organisations (862+ orgs, filterable by country/type/sector, browsable without login). Registered orgs can then publish Events (/en/latest/events), Training offers, News and Pledges. TWO DISTINCT ASSETS: the Organisation profile (durable citation surface) and per-edition Event entries for the conference. Eligibility is broad ('the Platform is for everyone'); the working gate is that the org acts to boost digital skills in Europe - a community property qualifies straightforwardly. No link-back requirement. DO NOT submit a personal-brand property (individual practice, not an organisation) or a talent-network property (does not fit the mandate).

targets.name: Bolster
targets.notes: Best US target for the person entity. US executive talent marketplace, 20,000+ execs, sources full-time / fractional / board / advisory. Entry is the 'Add Your Profile' CTA on the homepage - pages.bolster.com/join, /join-the-network and /executives all 404 on direct fetch, so the profile builder sits behind the CTA plus login. ELIGIBILITY: PASS - no US-residency, US-entity, work-authorization or W-9 gate stated on any public page. The real constraint is demand-side, not eligibility: Bolster's own comparison content describes it as US-centric with limited non-US reach, so a Czech operator registers fine but surfaces mainly for US-remote engagements. No link-back requirement. UNVERIFIED: the logged-in signup form's fields - a tax or residency question could appear there.

targets.name: Featured.com
targets.notes: US expert-source platform, the HARO successor. Experts answer publisher questions; selected answers publish on US media sites, MOST CARRYING A DOFOLLOW LINK BACK TO YOUR SITE - the link flows toward us, which is the point, and it compounds with any ongoing AI-citation measurement you run. Open platform, no signup criteria, free account instant; quality control happens at answer selection, not registration. A public expert profile page is created. ELIGIBILITY: PASS - no US address, entity or residency requirement anywhere on the signup path. NO link-back obligation on our side, so Law 1 is not engaged. FRICTIONS: 3 answers/month on the free tier, and low-effort AI answers get rejected - this needs real writing time, it is not a fire-and-forget listing. METHOD NOTE: featured.com rate-limited automated fetches (HTTP 429 twice) - verified via its own sign-up page and blog documentation, not a direct homepage read.

targets.notes: Expert-advice call marketplace (Startups.com), 30,000+ experts, US/startup buyer base, confirmed live in 2026 via site footer and an actively maintained help centre. PUBLIC INDEXABLE PROFILE at clarity.fm/{handle} - genuine citation value, not just a lead channel, which is what separates it from BetterUp/CoachHub/Exec. MECHANICS: Expert account via email or LinkedIn, 5-step application, human review ~24h, revisions emailed if rejected. ELIGIBILITY: PASS - no US residency or entity requirement; experts listed from cities worldwide. No link-back requirement. The pricing page confirms ALL tiers including free include 'Appear in Reporter's Expert Database', so the free tier does produce a listed expert profile. ELIGIBILITY: PASS - no country, entity or residency restriction stated on the site or pricing page. No link-back requirement. WEAKER THAN Featured.com (DIR-0088): 2 pitches/month plus a 2-hour delay behind paying users; the $149/month Pro tier is hard to justify for one practice. Register free, do not upgrade. UNVERIFIED: whether the expert profile is publicly indexable on the open web or visible only inside the reporter-facing database - the /sources page returned an image rather than readable text.

targets.notes: Smallest effort-to-result ratio in the Europe pass: one open form, NO ACCOUNT, free, moderated, Europe-only scope that already carries Czech events - so a conference property lands with near-certainty. Re-verify the exact submit path in a browser before the first submission; the events index was confirmed live but the add-event form path was not clicked end-to-end.

targets.notes: The most complete calendar of agile conferences and community events in CZ and SK; organisers contribute directly. Submission is by email to the operator; regular contributors get their Google account granted edit rights. Subscribable as a Google Calendar. LOCALIZE GATE: a community property passes; a conference property blocked until /cs/ ships. Found; mechanics confirmed by search, not fetched end-to-end.
